summary.intent: Debug BYO-IPFS register-cid 400 errors on staging by identifying why the load test's register-cid and ipns-publish calls were failing against the staging API.
summary.outcome: Discovered setByoStatus() was a dead service method with no controller endpoint (causing 403, not 400), fixed the load test's ipns-publish DTO mismatch, added PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint, centralized encryption mode selection into sdk-core, and fixed ~9 pre-existing API test type errors.

repo: setByoStatus() existed as a VaultService method but had no controller endpoint and was never called — BYO mode could not be enabled via any API call
The load test's ipns-publish call was sending {ipnsName, cid} but PublishIpnsEntryDto requires {ipnsName, record, metadataCid} with a signed IPNS record
STREAMING_MIME_TYPES was duplicated between packages/sdk/src/client.ts and apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts — centralized to packages/sdk-core/src/encryption-mode.ts
The tee-worker was moved from /tee-worker to /apps/tee-worker in Phase 35 (merged to main during this session)
API test files systemically used jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> pattern which loses mock method types after module.get() — a recurring issue across republish, tee, shares, and vault specs
The openapi.json spec file belongs at packages/api-client/openapi.json, not apps/api/openapi.json
orval generation creates model files for all endpoints including newly merged Phase 35 TEE worker endpoints — all generated files must be staged, not just specific ones
.husky/commit-msg.pre-entire is a local Entire CLI artifact that should be in .git/info/exclude, not committed to the repo

code.finding: New centralized module for selectEncryptionMode(mimeType, size) and normalizeEncryptionMode() — both sdk/client.ts and streaming-crypto.service.ts now import from here
uploadFile now calls selectEncryptionMode() to pick CTR for media files >256KB before calling sdkCore.uploadFile — mode is passed through the call chain
New PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint wiring setByoStatus() service method, returns SetByoStatusResponseDto
createByoClientPool now calls PATCH /vault/byo-status to enable BYO on each test account after creation, filters out failed enables and throws if zero accounts succeed
ipns-publish step replaced with createAndPublishIpnsRecord from sdk-core (was sending wrong DTO fields); createSdkContext hoisted outside iteration loop
RequestWithUser must be imported and used as the mock request type — using Request & {user:...} inline doesn't satisfy the controller's param types

workflow: When staging api-client generated files after orval regeneration, always git add packages/api-client/src/ entirely — partial staging causes CI typecheck failures on missing barrel exports
The jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> + module.get() pattern loses mock types — use the mock object directly instead of re-fetching from the module
Pre-existing test type errors should be fixed as part of any PR touching those modules to avoid CI noise accumulation
When an API error is described as '400' in a todo, verify it's actually validation vs auth (403) before debugging — the todo misidentified a 403 BYO check as a 400
Local Entire CLI hook artifacts (commit-msg.pre-entire) belong in .git/info/exclude, not committed to the repo

friction: openapi.json accidentally written to apps/api/openapi.json (cwd) instead of packages/api-client/openapi.json during manual generation — required a follow-up commit to remove
orval generation requires the API server to be running and returns the live spec — partial file staging caused CI typecheck failures on missing model barrel exports
GraphQL API for fetching PR review threads timed out repeatedly — had to fall back to REST API
Background task for api-client regeneration completed after the commit was already made, causing confusion about whether files were included
.husky/commit-msg.pre-entire was committed to the repo when it should have stayed local — required revert
open_items: The stale pending todo copy (sdk-uploadfile-hardcodes-gcm) ended up in both done/ and pending/ after the merge — cleanup was done but the merge process should prevent this
setByoStatus service method now has an endpoint but the web app Settings UI may still not be calling it — verify the Settings UI actually toggles BYO mode via the new endpoint
Integration tests in packages/sdk are pre-existing failures hitting a live API — not fixed in this session
FLAC added to STREAMING_MIME_TYPES but no E2E test coverage for FLAC streaming specifically
